description: First playable bodybuilding simulator: 16 training stations, 5 muscle groups, weight tiers, stamina, trainer boosts, coins, rebirths, session reward and optional DataStore saving.

commands.name: BenchTraining
commands.source:
-- Bodybuilding progression v2. Generated by Studio Bridge; server owns rewards.
local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local DataStoreService=game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local RunService=game:GetService("RunService")
local folder=workspace:WaitForChild("BodybuildingBuild",30)
if not folder then warn("[Bodybuilding] Build missing") return end
local store=DataStoreService:GetDataStore("BodybuildingProgressV2")
local MUSCLES={"Chest","Back","Arms","Legs","Abs"}
local sessions={}
local busy={}
local tiers={
 {name="Beginner",gain=1,cost=8,required=0},
 {name="Iron",gain=2,cost=13,required=80},
 {name="Steel",gain=4,cost=19,required=350},
 {name="Titan",gain=8,cost=27,required=1200},
 {name="Champion",gain=16,cost=38,required=5000}
}
local function total(player)
 local t=0
 for _,m in ipairs(MUSCLES) do t+=player:GetAttribute(m) or 0 end
 return t
end
local function sync(player)
 local s=sessions[player]
 if not s then return end
 player:SetAttribute("TotalMuscle",total(player))
 player:SetAttribute("MaxStamina",100+s.rebirths*10)
 player:SetAttribute("WeightTier",s.tier)
 player:SetAttribute("Coins",s.coins)
 player:SetAttribute("Rebirths",s.rebirths)
 player:SetAttribute("Multiplier",1+s.rebirths*.5+s.trainer*.25)
 player:SetAttribute("TrainerLevel",s.trainer)
 local stats=player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
 if stats then
  for name,value in pairs({Muscle=total(player),Coins=s.coins,Rebirths=s.rebirths}) do
   local v=stats:FindFirstChild(name)
   if v then v.Value=value end
  end
 end
end
local function message(player,text)
 player:SetAttribute("TrainingStatus",text)
end
local function setup(player)
 local saved
 local ok,result=pcall(function() return store:GetAsync("p_"..player.UserId) end)
 if ok and type(result)=="table" then saved=result end
 local s={coins=0,rebirths=0,tier=1,trainer=0,claimed=false}
 if saved then
  for _,k in ipairs({"coins","rebirths","tier","trainer"}) do
   if type(saved[k])=="number" then s[k]=math.max(0,math.floor(saved[k])) end
  end
 end
 s.tier=math.clamp(s.tier,1,#tiers)
 s.trainer=math.clamp(s.trainer,0,20)
 sessions[player]=s
 local stats=player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats") or Instance.new("Folder")
 stats.Name="leaderstats" stats.Parent=player
 for _,name in ipairs({"Muscle","Coins","Rebirths"}) do
  local v=stats:FindFirstChild(name) or Instance.new("IntValue")
  v.Name=name v.Parent=stats
 end
 for _,m in ipairs(MUSCLES) do
  local value=saved and saved[m] or 0
  player:SetAttribute(m,type(value)=="number" and math.max(0,math.floor(value)) or 0)
 end
 player:SetAttribute("Stamina",100+s.rebirths*10)
 player:SetAttribute("Training",false)
 sync(player)
 message(player,"Train at any station with E")
end
local function save(player)
 local s=sessions[player]
 if not s then return end
 local data={coins=s.coins,rebirths=s.rebirths,tier=s.tier,trainer=s.trainer}
 for _,m in ipairs(MUSCLES) do data[m]=player:GetAttribute(m) or 0 end
 local ok,err=pcall(function() store:UpdateAsync("p_"..player.UserId,function() return data end) end)
 if not ok then warn("[Bodybuilding] Save failed: "..tostring(err)) end
end
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(setup)
for _,p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do task.spawn(setup,p) end
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(p) save(p) sessions[p]=nil busy[p]=nil end)
game:BindToClose(function()
 for _,p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do save(p) end
end)
task.spawn(function()
 while task.wait(90) do for _,p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do save(p) end end
end)
local elapsed=0
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
 elapsed+=dt
 if elapsed<1 then return end
 local ticks=math.floor(elapsed) elapsed-=ticks
 for _,p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
  if sessions[p] and not busy[p] then
   p:SetAttribute("Stamina",math.min(p:GetAttribute("MaxStamina") or 100,(p:GetAttribute("Stamina") or 0)+5*ticks))
  end
 end
end)
local function promptFor(name,action,object,callback)
 local part=folder:FindFirstChild(name)
 if not part or not part:IsA("BasePart") then warn("[Bodybuilding] Missing station "..name) return end
 local prompt=part:FindFirstChild("GymPrompt") or Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
 prompt.Name="GymPrompt" prompt.ActionText=action prompt.ObjectText=object
 prompt.KeyboardKeyCode=Enum.KeyCode.E prompt.MaxActivationDistance=10
 prompt.HoldDuration=.2 prompt.RequiresLineOfSight=false prompt.Parent=part
 prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
  if not sessions[player] then return end
  local root=player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
  local hum=player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
  if not root or not hum or hum.Health<=0 or (root.Position-part.Position).Magnitude>12 then return end
  callback(player)
 end)
end
local function lift(player,muscle,station)
 if busy[player] then return end
 local s=sessions[player] if not s then return end
 local tier=tiers[s.tier]
 local max=player:GetAttribute("MaxStamina") or 100
 local stamina=player:GetAttribute("Stamina") or max
 if stamina<tier.cost then message(player,"Rest to recover stamina") return end
 busy[player]=true
 player:SetAttribute("Training",true)
 player:SetAttribute("TrainingStation",station)
 player:SetAttribute("Stamina",stamina-tier.cost)
 message(player,"Lifting "..tier.name.." weights...")
 task.wait(1.35)
 if player.Parent and sessions[player] then
  local gain=math.floor(10*tier.gain*(1+s.rebirths*.5+s.trainer*.25))
  player:SetAttribute(muscle,(player:GetAttribute(muscle) or 0)+gain)
  s.coins+=math.max(1,math.floor(gain/3))
  sync(player)
  message(player,"+"..gain.." "..muscle.." | +"..math.max(1,math.floor(gain/3)).." coins")
  player:SetAttribute("LastGain",gain)
 end
 if player.Parent then player:SetAttribute("Training",false) end
 busy[player]=nil
end
local stationList={
 {"BenchSeat","Chest","Bench Press"},
 {"ChestPressSeat","Chest","Chest Press"},{"InclinePressSeat","Chest","Incline Press"},{"PecFlySeat","Chest","Pec Fly"},
 {"LatPulldownSeat","Back","Lat Pulldown"},{"SeatedRowSeat","Back","Seated Row"},{"DeadliftSeat","Back","Deadlift"},
 {"BicepCurlSeat","Arms","Bicep Curl"},{"TricepPushdownSeat","Arms","Tricep Pushdown"},{"ShoulderPressSeat","Arms","Shoulder Press"},
 {"LegPressSeat","Legs","Leg Press"},{"LegExtensionSeat","Legs","Leg Extension"},{"CalfRaiseSeat","Legs","Calf Raise"},
 {"CrunchBenchSeat","Abs","Crunches"},{"CableCrunchSeat","Abs","Cable Crunch"},{"HangingLegRaiseSeat","Abs","Leg Raises"}
}
for _,row in ipairs(stationList) do
 local name,muscle,action=row[1],row[2],row[3]
 promptFor(name,action,muscle.." Training",function(p) lift(p,muscle,action) end)
end
for i,tier in ipairs(tiers) do
 local index=i
 promptFor("WeightTierPedestal"..(i-1),"Equip "..tier.name,"Weight Selection",function(p)
  local s=sessions[p]
  if total(p)<tier.required then message(p,"Requires "..tier.required.." total muscle") return end
  s.tier=index sync(p) message(p,"Equipped "..tier.name.." weights")
 end)
end
promptFor("TrainerDesk","Hire Trainer","Training Boost",function(p)
 local s=sessions[p]
 local cost=100*(s.trainer+1)^2
 if s.trainer>=20 then message(p,"Trainer at max level") return end
 if s.coins<cost then message(p,"Trainer costs "..cost.." coins") return end
 s.coins-=cost s.trainer+=1 sync(p)
 message(p,"Trainer level "..s.trainer.." unlocked")
end)
promptFor("DailyRewardKiosk","Claim Reward","Daily Bonus",function(p)
 local s=sessions[p]
 if s.claimed then message(p,"Reward already claimed this session") return end
 s.claimed=true s.coins+=150 sync(p) message(p,"Daily reward: +150 coins")
end)
promptFor("RebirthAltar","Rebirth","Prestige",function(p)
 local s=sessions[p]
 local required=5000*(s.rebirths+1)
 if total(p)<required then message(p,"Rebirth needs "..required.." total muscle") return end
 s.rebirths+=1 s.tier=1
 for _,m in ipairs(MUSCLES) do p:SetAttribute(m,0) end
 p:SetAttribute("Stamina",100+s.rebirths*10)
 sync(p) message(p,"Rebirth "..s.rebirths.."! Permanent multiplier increased")
end)
print("[Bodybuilding] Training stations and progression initialized")
